attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Opposition to amnesty.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The rule of law suffers if government policies encourage or reward illegal activity.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The American people reject en masse legalizations, especially given the federal government's past failures to enforce the law.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today's immigrants are seeking the American dream and contributing culturally and economically to the U.S.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. celebrates the industry and love of liberty of immigrants.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Both government and the private sector must do more to foster legally present immigrants' integration into American life to advance respect for the rule of law and a common American identity.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"It is a national disgrace that new Americans' first experience is with a dysfunctional immigration bureaucracy defined by delay and confusion, and this will no longer be tolerated.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Everyone—immigrants and native-born alike—must embrace the core values of liberty, equality, meritocracy, and respect for human dignity and the rights of women.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
